name: services/guide/chapters
description: Get university guide chapters by its ids. You may think of chapters as of categories that group pages on similar topic.

arguments.name: chapter_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of guide chapter ids as described in chapter method.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: A code of the preferred language ("pl" or "en"). It may influence the order of pages in the chapter.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of chapter method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary that will map your chapter_ids to chapter objects, as defined in the chapter method.
